ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 105

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

6. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 11
   C. 8
   D. 12

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

12. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

21. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 13

22. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

24. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
